source: AstroSage KP planet-to-house / house-to-planet significator table
provenance: AstroSage (https://www.astrosage.com) KP significator output for the User 1 Kolkata birth data. This is NOT a JHora export and NOT a founder-hand-worked fixture, so it is NOT a parity judge under AGENTS.md Rule 8. It is stored only as an external compatibility reference for the node-aware significator engine. The JHora final 4-level significator table for this chart is unavailable; until it exists, no engine output may claim JHora significator parity (DECISIONS.md D028).
caveats: AstroSage uses its own ayanamsa/house-cusp and node-agency conventions, which differ from this project's JHora-aligned engine (KP-Newcomb ayanamsa, Placidus, JHora D024 bhava-span house occupation).

AstroSage places/represents both nodes against houses {6,12} for this chart, while our JHora-bhava occupation puts Rahu in house 1 and Ketu in house 7 (D024). Node significator divergence is therefore rooted in a house-placement/convention difference, not only in agency rules.
Differences against this table are expected and must be reported honestly, never tuned away.
